"""Offline algorithm comparison, never an original reader or admission receipt."""
import ast,json,time,hashlib,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from astrolabe.research_panel import frame
from astrolabe.feature_store.source_run import _pair
from astrolabe.feature_store.admission import content_hash
root=Path('data-dumps/fs2_capture_92e1a92ad25144e48ecf15b46bf2db6e').resolve()
policy,ack=_pair(root,'frame_policy');persisted,_=_pair(root,'frame_report')
oldcommit='884adb6c74c1937fa5e1a3dce10f27add26d5e3d'
source=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',oldcommit+':backend/astrolabe/research_panel/frame.py']).decode()
# Extract only identical algorithm dependencies plus old parse_page. No source package
# mutation or patched build guard; explicitly not the read_frame admission interface.
names={'parse_page','_page_facts','_inventory','_summarize'}
nodes=[n for n in ast.parse(source).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name in names]
assert len(nodes)==4
ns=dict(vars(frame));exec(compile(ast.Module(body=nodes,type_ignores=[]),'<original algorithm diagnostic>','exec'),ns)
result={'decision':'D104','scope':'Full saved-frame computational comparison only; no current-build admission of old data, new clocks, original-reader deadline change or prospective acceptance','original_commit':oldcommit,'candidate_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD']).decode().strip(),'root':str(root),'policy_hash':ack['payload_hash'],'script':Path(__file__).read_text(),'passes':[]}
output=Path('docs/implementation/PHASE_03_FULL_FRAME_HASH_BENCHMARK.json')
expected=None
for label,inventory,summarize in [('original',ns['_inventory'],ns['_summarize']),('candidate',frame._inventory,frame._summarize)]:
 print(json.dumps({'started':label}),flush=True);start=time.perf_counter_ns()
 summary=summarize(policy,ack,inventory(root,policy,ack));elapsed=time.perf_counter_ns()-start
 assert all(persisted[k]==v for k,v in summary.items())
 if expected is not None:assert summary==expected
 expected=summary
 item={'implementation':label,'elapsed_ns':elapsed,'summary_hash':content_hash(summary),'source_rows':summary['source_rows'],'verified_attempts':summary['verified_attempts'],'all_persisted_summary_fields_match':True}
 result['passes'].append(item);output.write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(item),flush=True)
